summary: Verified the 401->409 GitHub-OAuth-repos fix and the frontend interceptor exclusion for /github/oauth/* and /github/app/*. Backend pytest (2/2), frontend vitest (3/3), and live E2E all confirm the specific 'auto sign-out on Add-repository wizard' regression is fixed. No regression on legitimate session-expiry safety net.

tests_executed.name: backend pytest test_iter_2026_09_09_oauth_repos_revoked_token.py
tests_executed.evidence: 409 returned with 'reconnect' detail; 502 for other GitHub errors; no raw traceback leak

tests_executed.name: frontend vitest api.sessionExpired.test.js
tests_executed.evidence: 401 on /github/oauth/repos does NOT dispatch aurem:session-expired; 401 on /github/app/installations does NOT dispatch; 401 on /cto/projects STILL dispatches

tests_executed.name: live curl GET /api/aurem-dev/github/oauth/repos with valid JWT for account with revoked GitHub OAuth
tests_executed.evidence: HTTP 409, body: 'Your GitHub connection expired — please reconnect.'

tests_executed.name: live curl GET /api/aurem-dev/auth/me with bad JWT
tests_executed.evidence: HTTP 401 (safety net for legitimate session expiry intact)

tests_executed.name: E2E smoke: login as test@aurem.dev and open dashboard (account has confirmed revoked GitHub OAuth, banner visible)
tests_executed.evidence: Token persists in localStorage, no navigation to /login, auth/me calls succeed. rail-add-repo test-id not rendered in current rail layout so wizard-open click could not be exercised, but the underlying regression (any 401 from /github/oauth/* forcing full logout) is proven not to trigger.

action_items: Minor: In this preview build the `data-testid="rail-add-repo"` element is not rendered in the current dashboard rail layout (verified via querySelector — not in DOM even after dashboard fully mounts). This blocks a direct E2E click-through of the NewUserWizard open path from the sidebar. Not a blocker for THIS iteration's fix (it's proven by pytest + vitest + the live 409 curl), but if the rail 'Add repository' entrypoint is expected to be visible for standard logged-in users, main agent may want to double-check RailShell.jsx rendering conditions (Dashboard.jsx handleAddRepo, sidebar collapsed vs expanded state, or account/project state gating).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/github_oauth.py line ~577-581: fix is correctly implemented — status_code == 401 branch on the upstream httpx.HTTPStatusError is converted to HTTPException(409) with an actionable 'reconnect' detail. No raw exception text leaks. Good.

frontend/src/lib/api.js line ~113-116: exclusion list is a substring match on /github/oauth/ and /github/app/. Defense-in-depth is correctly narrow — will not accidentally exclude unrelated auth endpoints, will correctly exclude both current and future github/oauth/* and github/app/* paths.

The 409-vs-401 semantic is defensible: 401 = 'YOUR AUREM session is invalid'; 409 = 'a linked third-party resource is in conflict/stale state'. This aligns with common REST conventions and preserves the frontend's global-401-means-logout contract without special-casing.
test_credentials: Preview: test@aurem.dev / AuremTest2026! (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md; account confirmed to have a revoked GitHub OAuth link — 'GitHub access revoked for aurem-demo/frontend' banner visible on dashboard, which is the exact scenario the fix targets)
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 401->409 fix in routers/github_oauth.py + the /github/oauth/* & /github/app/* exclusion in lib/api.js interceptor are both live and verified end-to-end. The preview test account (test@aurem.dev) is a great fixture for this because it actually has a stale/revoked legacy GitHub OAuth link -- calling GET /api/aurem-dev/github/oauth/repos with its valid JWT returns real 409 body. The rail-add-repo data-testid not being visible in DOM was NOT blocking the fix verification but may be a separate rail-layout concern to look at.
rca of the issue: User complaint: 'clicking Add repository / Continue with GitHub App signs me out instead of opening install flow, and the install popup never auto-closes after picking a repo.' RCA: NewUserWizard auto-called GET /github/oauth/repos on mount when legacy OAuth status was connected=true, even if the stored GitHub token was revoked on GitHub's side. Server returned 401 (from a prior fix) -> frontend global axios response interceptor treated ANY 401 as AUREM-JWT-dead -> wiped localStorage aurem_token and window.location.href='/login' -> the whole browser session was force-logged-out BEFORE the user ever clicked Continue with GitHub App, AND the install popup never got a chance to run postMessage+auto-close because the parent tab was already gone. Mitigation shipped in TWO layers: (1) backend returns 409 (semantic: 'linked third-party resource conflict') instead of 401 so the two states can never collide; (2) frontend interceptor also explicitly excludes /github/oauth/* and /github/app/* URLs from the aurem:session-expired dispatch as defense-in-depth. Both layers verified passing here.
